title: SSR: Structural Signal Retriever for Scalable Agent Discovery in LLM-Orchestrated Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.21113v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large-scale multi-agent ecosystems require mechanisms for discovering suitable agents without exposing entire registries to a large language model (LLM) orchestrator. The challenge is not only to retrieve relevant Agent Cards from a growing registry, but also to maintain a compact candidate context, since each additional candidate increases prompt size, inference cost, latency, and the risk of exceeding the model context window. We formulate this problem as candidate-context scalability and propose the Structural Signal Retriever (SSR), our deterministic and training-free retrieval method designed for Agent Card discovery. SSR derives structural lexical signals from capability-bearing Agent Card fields, weights them using inverse document frequency (IDF), and uses an Inverted Signal Index (ISI) for selective candidate scoring. translated_title: SSR：面向LLM编排多智能体系统中可扩展智能体发现的结构信号检索器
translated_abstract: 大规模多智能体生态系统需要在不向大型语言模型（LLM）编排器暴露整个注册表的前提下发现合适智能体的机制。挑战不仅在于从不断增长的注册表中检索相关的智能体卡，还在于维护紧凑的候选上下文，因为每增加一个候选都会增大提示词规模、推理成本、延迟，以及超出模型上下文窗口的风险。我们将该问题表述为候选上下文可扩展性问题，并提出了结构信号检索器（SSR），这是一种为智能体卡发现设计的确定性、无需训练的检索方法。SSR从承载能力的智能体卡字段中提取结构化词法信号，使用逆文档频率（IDF）对其进行加权，并利用倒排信号索引（ISI）进行选择性候选评分。我们通过合成智能体基准、公开的MS MARCO改编数据集以及端到端的LLM编排对SSR进行了评估。
tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的确定性检索方法SSR，通过从智能体卡中提取结构化词法信号、结合IDF加权与倒排信号索引，实现了LLM编排多智能体系统中可扩展、低成本的智能体发现。
en_tdlr: SSR is a deterministic, training-free retrieval method that extracts structural lexical signals from Agent Cards, weighted by IDF and scored via an Inverted Signal Index, enabling scalable and cost-efficient agent discovery in LLM-orchestrated multi-agent systems.
